# Mini Brains Play

> An Australian iOS app of hundreds of screen-free play ideas for children aged 2 to 7, sorted by time, mess, age and mood. The app is for the parent; the child plays in the real world. Built around eight learning strengths and the Australian Curriculum by an Australian mum. Free to download, no ads.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://minibrainsplay.com.au/): what Mini Brains Play is and how it works
- [About](https://minibrainsplay.com.au/about/): the Australian family behind it
- [School readiness](https://minibrainsplay.com.au/school-readiness/): getting your child ready for their first year of school
- [Pricing](https://minibrainsplay.com.au/pricing/): plans and what's included
- [FAQ](https://minibrainsplay.com.au/faq/): common questions from parents
